newsitem.title: USA: Houghten target of complaint out of merger.
newsitem.headline: Houghten target of complaint out of merger.

text.p: Houghten Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday that a complaint has been filed against the company and its officers in a dispute over its acquisition of ChromaXome Corp.
The complaint was filed by Michael Dickman and Katie Thompson, the founders of ChromaXome, who accuse Houghten of denying them access to and employment with ChromaXone.
The company said the complaint also accuses it of preventing Dickman and Thompson from obtaining certain consideration in connection with the acquisition.
The complaint was filed in Superior Court in San Diego.
Houghten said the claims are without merit.

Houghten develops and uses combinatorial chemistry and other molecular diversity technologies to pursue the discovery of small-molecule drug therapies. ChromaXome, now a wholly owned subisidiary, was a privately held combinatorial company.
